<insights>
- The Mid-South Conference was originally known as the Gulf South Conference.
- The Gulf South Conference was formed in the summer of 1970.
- The charter members were Delta State, Florence State (now North Alabama), Jacksonville State, Livingston (now West Alabama), Tennessee–Martin, and Troy State (now Troy).
</insights>

<answer>
The founding year of the Mid-South Conference affiliate-member school whose city has a large reddish-colored structure next to a rectangle-shaped body of water is 1970.
</answer>
